snippet.title: Cat Isle Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cat Isle Demo has launched!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4344670/Cat_Isle_Demo
Discord: https://discord.gg/ucv6hdc9cn

In this cozy pixel art management game, build restaurants, play gashapon, decorate the town and interact with cats. Figure out your cats needs as they dine, shop, explore and turn the island into their purfect home.

Website: https://domke.games/catisle/
Itch.io: https://domkegames.itch.io/cat-isle
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pixelduckoo/
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@domkegames
X: https://x.com/DomkeGames
